description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

HII’s Uncrewed Systems team is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to develop Odyssey Mission, a web-based command-and-control interface for unmanned surface and underwater vehicles. The role builds React and TypeScript frontends and Java Spring Boot services, integrating with vehicle hardware and external systems to support mission planning, live monitoring, and analysis.
Junior Full-Stack Software Engineer building React/TypeScript and Spring Boot applications, APIs, and live telemetry for multi-vehicle operations

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with designers, operators, and software and systems engineers to translate mission workflows into intuitive interfaces; use prototypes and user feedback to refine designs and reduce operator workload
• Implement and optimize React and TypeScript frontend components and Java Spring Boot backend services for responsive, reliable multi-vehicle operation
• Develop REST APIs and WebSocket interfaces for live telemetry, vehicle status, and mission commands, with clear handling of delayed data, connection loss, and errors
• Integrate with external applications, vehicle interfaces, and databases such as MongoDB and InfluxDB, using protocols such as DDS (Data Distribution Service)
• Write clean, modular, and maintainable code; participate in peer reviews and follow coding standards, secure development practices, and automated build and test workflows
• Develop automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
• Debug across the UI, backend, network, and hardware interfaces using simulators, hardware-in-the-loop testing, and vehicle testing as needed
• Evaluate frontend and backend technologies and practices to improve application usability, performance, and maintainability
• Work with product owners and customers to define requirements and acceptance criteria; contribute to Agile planning, demonstrations, and iterative delivery of mission capabilities
• Document application changes, API contracts, and integration behavior for frontend, backend, and hardware-facing components
• Designs, develops, documents, tests and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions
• Conducts multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software
• Determines computer user needs; analyzes system capabilities to resolve problems on program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques and controls; prepares operating instructions; designs and develops compilers and assemblers, utility programs, and operating systems
• Ensures software standards are met

Requirements:
• Level 1 - 0 years experience with Bachelors in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 4 years relevant experience
• Level 2 - 2 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; 0 years experience with Masters in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 6 years relevant experience
• BS/MS Degree in CS, CE, EE or a related field
• Experience in full stack development 1-2 years
• In-depth knowledge of Java (Spring Boot), TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
• Experience with modern React development, reusable components, state management, and frontend build and test tools
• Experience designing and implementing user interfaces informed by user feedback
• Experience with browser-based debugging and performance testing software
• Must be able to obtain and maintain a government clearance
• Excellent troubleshooting skills across frontend, backend, and system interfaces

Preferred:
• geospatial, telemetry, or other data-intensive interfaces are a plus
